newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile supermarkets D&S to invest $100 mln.
newsitem.headline: Chile supermarkets D&S to invest $100 mln.

text.p: Chilean supermarket chain D&S said it will invest $100 million this year in expanding its network of stores in Chile and Argentina.
"The bulk of the investment will be in Chile," D&S general manager Nicolas Ibanez told reporters at the company's annual stockholders' meeting.
In Chile, the firm's projects include new stores in Santiago and the seaside resort of Vina del Mar, he said.
Argentine plans include building another supermarket in addition to the three stores the firm already operates in Buenos Aires, said Ibanez.
The investments will be financed by proceeds from a $50 million capital increase last year with the balance coming from the company's own resources and debt, he said.
